correctness.rationale: An invariant barycentric point of the complex of bipartite simple edge sets has coefficients constant on each translation edge orbit. Over V=F2^r each nonzero difference d gives one orbit of unordered edges, a perfect matching. The union of selected orbits forms Cay(V,S), which is bipartite exactly when a nonzero linear character ell maps all selected differences to 1. Thus the fixed space is PL-identical, GL(r,2)-naturally, to the affine hyperplane complex. Its simplex-facet intersections are affine flats avoiding zero. Intersections organize a pure geometric semilattice to which the cited Ziegler EL-shellability theorem applies; nerve/intersection-poset equivalence yields a wedge of (r−1)-spheres. Counting nonzero cosets of codim-k directions and Möbius inversion produces the stated recurrence and free integral homology ranks. Independently brute checked all selections for r=2,3 and evaluated b2=1,b3=6,b4=91,b5=2820,b6=177661. This is not an all-r computational proof.
